mod_name: Godlike Campaign Overhaul - Hammer and Backpacks
short_description: An overpowered offline campaign overhaul for Red Faction Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered: tougher Alec, a stronger hammer, retuned backpacks, more ammo and cheaper upgrades. Includes both VPP archives. Archive and data checks passed; gameplay testing is still needed.
main_file_description: Full V4.2 package: misc.vpp_pc, table.vpp_pc, a Vietnamese installation guide and SHA-256 checksums. Back up and replace both archives manually. No earlier release required. Gameplay testing is still pending; read the mod page before installing.
optional_file_description: Optional parameter inventories, validation reports, theoretical fuel calculations and build/verification scripts. Not required to play.
additional_mod_requirements: None for the VPP package. The separate RSL jump addon is not included or required.
publication_status: Draft for manual Nexus Mods submission; not posted to Nexus by this task.
